selectedRecipes.evidence: Current item-use spell lists eight named cards; each is a random Darkmoon Card of War output, not a guaranteed specific craft.

selectedRecipes.name: Xiwyllag ATV

specialties.name: Cursed Haunch
specialties.summary: Uncommon Cursed Haunch from eligible Drustvar beasts; used for the cosmetic Heartsbane Hexwurst food.
tips: Kill and loot Betsy near Fallhaven; Cursed Haunch is a loot drop, not the skinning result.
Reports also name Gorehorn and hexcrazed beasts, but yield reports conflict; treat it as a low and variable chance.
Sell the meat or craft Heartsbane Hexwurst after learning the recipe from Raal the Gluttonous in Waycrest Manor.

spots.location: Betsy near Fallhaven; documented rare location

specialties.name: Recipe: Heartsbane Hexwurst
specialties.summary: Tradeable Recipe: Heartsbane Hexwurst from Raal the Gluttonous in Waycrest Manor.
tips: Defeat and loot Raal the Gluttonous; the item is the recipe, not the cooked food.
Normal-difficulty drops are reported, so do not assume the recipe requires Mythic.
The recipe and Cursed Haunch can be sold separately; learning the recipe consumes it.

specialties.name: Gilded Seaweave
specialties.summary: Gilded Seaweave from Nazjatar humanoids, with additional later BfA assault-zone sources.
tips: Kill and loot naga humanoids in Nazjatar; skinning is not required for cloth.
Community reports identify the naga camp around 41,40 and Gorgonian Overlook around 49,39. The separate 59.14,56.60 report has conflicting replies and is not used as a fixed source pin.
Tailors can also obtain chance cloth from Synchronous Thread time-rift caches. No fixed cache output is assumed.
